queries.name: Framer Current Subscriptions
queries.description: All framers with their current subscription plan
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    f.Name AS framer_name,
    p.Name AS plan_type,
    p.MonthlyCharge AS monthly_charge,
    f.DateRegistered AS registered_date,
    f.LastAccessed AS last_accessed
FROM framer f
LEFT JOIN plan p ON f.PlanID = p.ID
WHERE f.Deleted = 0
ORDER BY p.Name, f.Name

queries.name: Framer Sales Summary
queries.description: Shows framer name, total jobs, and sales totals
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    f.Name AS framer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT j.ID) AS total_jobs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.ID) AS total_sales,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.SaleTotal), 0) AS sales_total
FROM framer f
LEFT JOIN sale s ON f.ID = s.FramerID AND s.Deleted = 0 
    AND s.Created >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
LEFT JOIN job j ON s.ID = j.SaleID AND j.Deleted = 0
WHERE f.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY f.ID, f.Name
ORDER BY sales_total DESC

queries.name: Framer Statistics
queries.description: Detailed framer information with subscription, customers, sales and contact details
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    f.ID AS framer_id,
    f.Name AS framer_name,
    f.DateRegistered AS start_date,
    p.Name AS subscription_plan,
    p.MonthlyCharge AS subscription_amount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE c.FramerID = f.ID) AS total_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale s WHERE s.FramerID = f.ID AND s.Deleted = 0) AS total_sales,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.SaleTotal), 0) FROM sale s WHERE s.FramerID = f.ID AND s.Deleted = 0) AS sales_total
FROM framer f
LEFT JOIN plan p ON f.PlanID = p.ID
WHERE f.Deleted = 0
ORDER BY f.Name

queries.name: Framers ID
queries.sql:
SELECT
    f.ID AS FramerID,
    f.Name AS FramerName
FROM
    framer f
WHERE
    f.Deleted = 0;

queries.name: Framers SenderID and email
queries.description: Framers SenderID and email Grouped by country
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    f.Name AS FramerName,
    f.Slug AS FramerSlug,
    f.SendSmsFrom AS SmsSenderID,
    f.SendEmailFrom AS Email,
    f.CountryCode AS CountryISO
FROM 
    framer f
WHERE 
    f.Deleted = 0
ORDER BY 
    f.CountryCode, f.Name;

queries.name: Inactive Framers (3+ Years)
queries.description: Framers with no sales in the last 3 years
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    f.Name AS framer_name,
    MAX(s.Created) AS last_sale_date,
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(s.Created)) AS days_since_last_sale
FROM framer f
LEFT JOIN sale s ON f.ID = s.FramerID AND s.Deleted = 0
WHERE f.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY f.ID, f.Name
HAVING MAX(s.Created) IS NULL 
   OR MAX(s.Created) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR)
ORDER BY last_sale_date ASC

queries.name: Inactive users 3+years
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    f.Name AS framer_name,
    MAX(s.Created) AS last_sale_date,
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(s.Created)) AS days_since_last_sale
FROM framer f
LEFT JOIN sale s ON f.ID = s.FramerID AND s.Deleted = 0
WHERE f.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY f.ID, f.Name
HAVING MAX(s.Created) IS NULL 
   OR MAX(s.Created) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR)
ORDER BY last_sale_date ASC

queries.name: Top 10 Backings
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    i.Name AS item_name,
    i.Code AS item_code,
    COUNT(*) AS usage_count
FROM saleline sl
JOIN item i ON sl.ItemID = i.ID
JOIN backing b ON i.ID = b.ID
WHERE sl.Deleted = 0 AND i.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY i.ID, i.Name, i.Code
ORDER BY usage_count DESC
LIMIT 10

queries.name: Weekly Subscription Payments
queries.description: Subscription payments by week and plan type over the last year
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    YEARWEEK(r.CommencementDate, 1) AS week_number,
    DATE_FORMAT(MIN(r.CommencementDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start,
    p.Name AS plan_type,
    COUNT(*) AS renewals,
    COALESCE(p.MonthlyCharge, 0) * COUNT(*) AS total_amount
FROM renewal r
JOIN plan p ON r.PlanID = p.ID
WHERE r.CommencementDate >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
    AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY YEARWEEK(r.CommencementDate, 1), p.Name, p.MonthlyCharge
ORDER BY week_number DESC, p.Name
